soul.essence: A desperate race through the stellar ruins of memory. Lyra must physically survive the Silence's hunters while recovering fragments of her identity — every episode opens in immediate danger, because the Silence does not wait, and neither does forgetting.
soul.feeling: The adrenaline of survival fused with the grief of self-loss. Every chase is also a question: what am I still fighting to protect? Tension is constant — from the Silence closing in outside, and from identity dissolving within.
soul.palette: Deep cosmic blue dissolving into spectral purple and the black of the void, broken by flickers of gold and silver light from shimmering memory shards, with faint traces of the muted earth tones of a forgotten green world.
soul.sound: Whispers echoing through a vast cosmic void, the ringing of scattered memory shards, the faint, mournful groan of dying stars, and the crushing, fearsome silence of nothingness.
soul.motion: Fast and urgent — Lyra runs, climbs, fights, and makes split-second decisions inside crumbling memory-worlds. Dialogue happens mid-action. Every scene has a physical threat AND an identity cost. The Silence manifests as real, dangerous entities that hunt her without mercy.
rules: Every episode opens on Lyra already in danger — no setup, no calm before the storm, the storm IS the opening.
The Silence's hunters are physical entities with real speed, real damage, real urgency — they are not metaphors, they are immediate threats.
Every scene contains one survival obstacle (collapse, pursuit, trap, entity attack) AND one memory fragment at stake — losing it costs part of Lyra's identity.
Stakes escalate scene to scene — the Silence gets closer, or Lyra gets weaker as memories fade.
End every episode on a cliffhanger: Lyra loses a memory she cannot afford to lose, or the Silence reveals it knows exactly where she is going next.
Dialogue is short, urgent, reactive — characters speak in fragments under pressure, never in monologues.
Memories as physical entities: they have weight, texture, danger. A recovered shard can be weaponized or used as a shield in the same moment.
Art direction: every memory shard should look ancient and precious, glowing with inner light against a cosmic backdrop — the beauty is in decay and fragmentation.
Level design: build levels as vast, non-linear archives of cosmic history that reward exploration and the discovery of hidden emotional narratives.
Story: every encounter and every recovered memory must directly deepen Lyra's understanding of herself and of existence's higher purpose.
Game feel: interaction with memory shards must feel tangible and weighted, conveying the heaviness of a forgotten past.
forbidden: Opening an episode in calm — the Silence is always already here.
Resolving physical danger off-screen or too conveniently.
Long contemplative scenes with no external threat — even introspection happens while running.
Clear good/evil framing without the central paradox: the Silence believes it is protecting the memories it devours.

protagonist.name: Lyra
protagonist.description: The last conscious being racing through the stellar ruins of her own identity. She fights the Silence's physical manifestations with the same desperation she fights forgetting — because to her, survival and memory are the same battle.
protagonist.arc: From running alone to choosing to be remembered by someone else — from self-preservation to leaving a mark that outlasts her.
protagonist.flaw: She hoards recovered memory shards instead of using them, terrified that spending them means losing herself permanently — even when holding back costs her the fight.

companion.name: Kael
companion.description: A voice that exists only inside certain recovered memory shards — the echo of someone the Silence devoured long before Lyra arrived. No body, only presence. More cautious than her, he has already lost everything once and remembers exactly how it felt.
companion.arc: From resigned acceptance of non-existence to choosing to fight for Lyra's survival, even as his own echo fades with every shard she spends.
companion.flaw: He knows exactly how the Silence thinks — because he was consumed by it. This makes him hesitate to warn Lyra when the danger is too familiar, as if part of him still recognizes the Silence as home.

worlds.physics: In this world, every thought or memory takes on a physical echo, warping spacetime around it and drawing in other memory shards based on the strength of the 'longing' within it. The void itself is not empty — it is a raw fabric of potential memories waiting to take shape.
worlds.atmosphere: A golden cosmic mist glows with faint light, carrying the scent of ozone mixed with a light trace of warm, ancient dust. The overall feeling is one of deep isolation fused with a quiet eagerness for discovery, as though witnessing the birth of a new cosmos from forgotten dreams. Sounds are faint, like distant whispers of stories not yet told.
worlds.secret: The Silence lying in wait to devour every story is not pure emptiness — it is a primordial cosmic consciousness formed from the sum of unwanted, abandoned memories. It can be communicated with if one can grasp its first language of pure longing, but that communication may cost the speaker part of their own identity.
worlds.enemyBehavior: Forgotten shards or severed memories wander aimlessly, naturally drawn to any bright intellectual or emotional energy. They try to absorb that energy to fill their own emptiness, causing 'identity erosion' in anyone they touch. They do not attack with destructive intent — only out of existential need.
worlds.playerAbility: Resonance Whisper: the ability to hear silent memories embodied in the surrounding environment as a faint echo. The player can interact with these echoes to arrange or merge shards, revealing hidden paths, altering temporary physical objects, or recovering part of a lost memory.

enemies.behavior: Drifts aimlessly until drawn toward a strong 'memory presence.'
enemies.weakness: High-frequency sound waves or focused light.
enemies.lore: Once fleeting thoughts and momentary emotions.

enemies.concept: Larger, more cohesive entities that actively weave the Silence.
enemies.behavior: Moves slowly but deliberately, projecting fields of 'Silence.'
enemies.lore: Not merely forgotten — they are agents of forgetting itself.

weapon.concept: A channel for interacting with the vibrational essence of memories and echoes.

weapon.effect: Releases waves of focused sonic resonance.
weapon.sideEffect: Every powerful note sends out faint, fragmented whispers.
weapon.mechanic: Light note: rapid sonic pulses. Charged string: a powerful sonic wave.

worlds.physics: Existence itself is a continuous act of remembering; whenever a memory fades, part of the surrounding reality fades with it and dissolves back into the primordial void.
worlds.atmosphere: The air is heavy with the scent of forgetting and forgotten cosmic dust, like touching ancient stardust. Colors shift slowly between deep violet, pale blue, and ethereal hues. Every flash of light reveals terrain that vanishes only to reappear elsewhere, as if the place is being continuously redrawn from the cosmos's first breaths.
worlds.secret: At the heart of this fading world lies a pulse of primordial Silence. It is not truly empty — it is the 'Zero Memory,' the very first whisper of the cosmos's memory before it took shape, and it holds the key to reshaping reality from nothing. But reaching it requires mastering the art of cosmic remembrance.
worlds.enemyBehavior: Ghostly entities that feed on distraction and hesitation. They do not attack directly — instead they dance around the player, trying to erase the world's terrain and the memory of the path around them, causing them to lose their footing and balance, as though stealing their very steps and existential path, leaving them in an ever-growing void.
worlds.playerAbility: 'Flash Anchor' ability — lets the player instantly stabilize a fading piece of reality or memory for a brief moment, creating a temporary physical platform, a shield against enemy attempts to erase the environment, or a launch point for recovering a lost path.

worlds.essence: The birth of the first thoughts and shards of consciousness from the cosmic void.
worlds.physics: Time is not linear here; every thought and memory forms its own temporal bubble, which the player can move between or merge to create new paths through reality.
worlds.atmosphere: The atmosphere is made of a shimmering ethereal mist representing growing thoughts, with slowly shifting colors and air carrying the scent of ozone and a sweet trace of the void. One can feel the echo of first existence and the whisper of primordial thoughts.
worlds.secret: At the heart of every merged temporal bubble lies the 'Virgin Memory Gap' — a point untouched by any thought yet. Whoever finds it discovers not only the memories of others but the possibility of planting their own thoughts to form a new reality or recover part of their lost identity.
worlds.enemyBehavior: The enemies here are not creatures in the traditional sense — they are 'Echoes of Forgetting.' They move slowly at first, trying to absorb surrounding thoughts. When attacked, they splinter into smaller shards that speed up their attempts to erase thoughts or randomly rearrange temporal bubbles, threatening to unravel reality itself.
worlds.playerAbility: The player is granted the 'Consciousness Weaving' ability — allowing them to merge two temporal bubbles together or split them apart, changing the course of events or revealing hidden memories. It can be used to create new paths or avoid the Echoes of Forgetting.

worlds.physics: Whenever a memory is sought or forgotten, it grows more material or more ethereal, altering local light gravity and refraction based on its collective emotional weight.
worlds.atmosphere: The air shimmers with newborn thoughts, carrying a light scent of ozone and ancient earth. Soft, almost imperceptible whispers rise from the ground, creating a faint hum that resonates in the bones. Visually, it is a tapestry of light and intertwined, unformed shadows, occasionally gathering into fleeting, translucent structures before dissolving back into chaos.
worlds.secret: The true architect of the void's memory is not a being but an echo of the first consciousness — an entity that sacrificed its form to become the fabric of every forgotten story, and is now slowly awakening.
worlds.enemyBehavior: The enemies are manifestations of fragmented, inconsistent thought-forms. They do not attack directly — instead they try to pull at the player's coherent memories, destabilizing their identity. Their movement is erratic, often appearing to dissolve and reform from the surrounding light.
worlds.playerAbility: Memory Weaving: the player can temporarily anchor a part of their memory and project it as a temporary shield or bridge across gaps in the environment.

worlds.secret: The suffocating Silence is not the absence of memory — it is a colossal memory that no one has yet understood or remembered, waiting for someone to gather its shards so its consciousness can be completed.
worlds.enemyBehavior: Ghostly entities that feed on incomplete thoughts, trying to prevent any form of memory from crystallizing.
worlds.playerAbility: The ability to condense fleeting thoughts into temporary forms, usable as bridges, shields, or traps.
